summary: Modulprüfungsordnung Chemie L3 of 30.01.2023, section 3: compulsory general, inorganic, organic, physical chemistry and didactics modules plus the practical semester, one of Komplexchemie/Koordinationschemie, and two of five advanced modules (at least one of OC IV or MC).

categories.name: Elective: complex or coordination chemistry
categories.note: One 5-ECTS module (KC A or KC B).

categories.name: Electives: advanced organic, organometallic or physical chemistry
categories.note: Two of five 5-ECTS modules, at least one of them Fortgeschrittenenpraktikum Organische Chemie or Metallorganische Chemie.

options.id: Modul 16 Vertiefung Polymere und nachhaltige Materialien

categories.name: At least one advanced organic or organometallic module
categories.nameDe: Mindestens Fortgeschrittenenpraktikum Organische Chemie oder Metallorganische Chemie
categories.note: Of the two Wahlpflicht modules (5 ECTS each), at least one must be Fortgeschrittenenpraktikum Organische Chemie or Metallorganische Chemie. The same module also counts toward the two-of-five choice, and taking both is allowed.
